# KR Mobile Car Detailing

> KR Mobile Car Detailing is a 100% mobile car detailing company based in Arlington, Virginia. We detail cars at the customer's home, apartment, condo or office in Arlington, Annandale, Tysons, Vienna, Merrifield and Northern Virginia. We bring our own water and power. Rated 4.9 out of 5 on Google from 146 reviews.

- Website: https://krmobilecardetailing.com/
- Email: info@krmobilecardetailing.com
- Phone: 571-571-1913
- Online booking: https://krmobilecardetailing.com/book/
- Fully mobile: no shop, no drop-off, no walk-ins. Appointment required.

## Packages and prices (USD, by vehicle size)

| Vehicle size | Exterior Detail | Interior Detail | Full Detail |
|---|---|---|---|
| Small Cars (Civic, Corolla, Mazda 3, Tesla Model 3) | $99 | $159 | $219 |
| Mid-Size Cars & Small SUVs (Camry, Accord, CR-V, RAV4, Tesla Model Y) | $119 | $179 | $259 |
| Large SUVs & Mid-Size Trucks (Highlander, Grand Cherokee, Tacoma, Tesla Model X) | $139 | $199 | $299 |
| Extra Large SUVs, Vans & Full-Size Trucks (Tahoe, Suburban, F-150, Sienna, Odyssey) | $159 | $229 | $329 |

Add-ons ($25 to $99) include pet hair removal, carpet and seat shampoo, odor treatment (ozone), mold and mildew treatment, water intrusion cleanup, vomit cleanup, child seat sanitation, synthetic paint sealant (6 months), RainShield glass protection, glass water spot removal, headlight restoration, wheel restoration, tar and sap removal, engine detail and heavy condition. Add-ons require a package.

## Service area

- No travel fee in Northern Virginia within about 15 miles of Annandale, VA (22003): Arlington, Annandale, Tysons, Vienna, Merrifield, Fairfax, Falls Church, Alexandria, Springfield, Burke, McLean and nearby areas.
- Washington DC and Maryland: subject to confirmation.

## Policies

- A card secures the appointment and is not charged at booking.
- Free cancellation or rescheduling up to 12 hours before. Late cancellations and no-shows may be charged $50.
- No fee when severe weather or an emergency cancels the appointment.
- Apartments, condos, offices and garages are fine when the property allows mobile detailing and our service vehicle can park next to the customer's car.
